avis.titre: I think this is my new favorite toner!I think this is my new favorite toner!
avis.texte: I bought this on a whim after watching a sponsored video by James Welsh. I know he only accepts sponsors if he genuinely loves and approves of a product so I trusted his judgment and I'm glad I did! I usually use Paula's Choice, Klairs, Hero etc but I've had good experiences in the past with Axis-Y. I shake it up really well then pour some onto a toner pad and swipe onto my face. It has a very thin consistency with a little more viscosity than water. It has a very, very subtle and pleasant scent. It doesn't burn my skin at all, in fact it feels very comforting. It hydrates well too. I also feel like it helps heal my acne a little faster than usual and my pores seem smaller and clearer. I have absolutely zero complaints and will continue to use and purchase this!
This duo has potential and IS an incredible product however it makes absolutely no sense that the serum is so tiny and that you cannot purchase them separately. Make it make sense!

Oily, acne prone skin. I’ve gone through about 3 bottles of this serum. I ran out once and wasn’t going to repurchase, then I noticed my skin texture was getting ruddy and rough again. I had to stop and think what I had cut out of my routine, and realized it was this serum! Repurchased and my skin has been smooth and glowy since!
It gave me such a severe chemical burn. Not sure what active is in it…but my face was burning as if I got a horrible sunburn

This stuff definitely isn't bad, but it's not as hydrating as I anticipated. I have dry and dehydrated skin and a compromised skin barrier. I'm looking for something to soothe while adding adequate moisture. Despite how fragranced these products are, they were actually soothing. These don't have added fragrance, though some of the ingredients have a fragrance so you do get natural fragrance. It's got an earthy balsam smell (most likely from the balsam resin). Normally strongly scented stuff does cause immediate irritation within seconds, but these did not. I had zero stinging or redness after using. I cannot say if it caused adverse reactions in terms of causing more breakouts since I've only been using it a short time, but I can tell you that my skin does feel calmer altogether. Though I don't feel hydrated and I really feel like I need another moisturizer after the "last step" listed in their process. I think if I could get more moisture from these products or find a moisturizer that will work with these products, I'd be a very happy camper. But I just feel sad that I have all these products and I still don't feel truly moisturized. My skin does feel very soft though!
This product is very hydrating, non-sticky, and effective at reducing redness and irritation, leaving the skin soft and plump.
This really improved my skin texture and I felt so hydrated and saw a drastic change in the brightness and quality of my skin. Perfect! I went through an entire bottle and will have to repurchase.
Honestly, been using this for over a month and my skin is baby soft. I wish I would have done a before and after cuz damn this stuff works lol. I use it at night daily with my other face routine.

This is the first product I've used from Korean AXIS-Y under the name Made for Me by Me. I had no expectations, I rarely do, it's not fair to the product. Being a member of the Vine Program, I test a lot of skin care products & for that reason I've learned a considerable amount about ingredients, formulations, percentages, combinations etc. It may have been because this toner is in relatively unassuming packaging, in an unassuming colour - I don't know but it really doesn't matter - what does matter is the surprise, a very pleasant one, I experienced when I used it for the first time. I had to do a double take in the mirror. My skin was glowing. I wondered if I had done anything different, anything that could account for this glow & nope, not a thing. I checked the ingredients & I saw that it had Mugwort* (not the best name for something to put on the skin, lol) AND Centella Asiatica both known for being extremely gentle for use on skin. It also has a number of other soothing & hydrating ingredients. I tried the toner repeatedly at other times & each time my skin looked & felt great. *I have a Mugwort serum, for a different brand which leaves an incredible glow on my skin. Just out of this world. Ich kann keinen nachvollziehbaren Grund finden, warum man ein Produkt verkauft, dessen Haltbarkeitsdatum in einem Monat abläuft. Es handelt sich nicht um ein Getränk, sondern um ein Kosmetikprodukt.
I used this ampule for like a month, and it really help calming down my redness and inflammation of my acne. Really worth every penny

avis.titre: Decent product, very comparable to other toners I've usedDecent product, very comparable to other toners I've used
avis.texte: I have been using this toner for some time now and I like it as far as toners go, but I don't notice anything different or see any different results from the toner I normally use. This is nice and the fragrance is not offensive. It does feel nice when I use it after cleansing my face and I am happy with that. I feel that the price is a little higher than I am used to paying and I have not experienced anything much different. It is a nice product, but I don't feel it is super special so justify the price.

avis.titre: Lightweight, nourishing, and full of powerhouse ingredients!
avis.texte: I love Korean skincare, so when I had the opportunity to try the Axis-Y brand, I was excited. For reference, I have combination, acne-prone skin with mild sensitivity. This essence is formulated with some real powerhouse ingredients, including a special blend of five pre and probiotics. One of the biggest worth mentioning is the presence of Bifida Ferment Lysate, which is a probiotic that strengthens the skin barrier and helps to reduce skin sensitivity. This should sound familiar if you use anything in Estée Lauder’s Advanced Night Repair skincare line, given that this is one of the main ingredients in these products. All in all, it seems to be formulated with good, skin-loving ingredients (after running it through a skincare checker), and it has no artificial fragrance, parabens, or dyes. The box arrived with the safety seal intact, and it even had another seal on the actual bottle. I really appreciate these extra steps because it provides peace of mind regarding the integrity of the product. It comes in a dropper bottle, which is great as it allows you to easily control the amount to use. I’ve found that a little goes a long way, and the size of the bottle is generous (1.69 ounces) compared to other serums/essences as they’re usually only 1 ounce. This essence feels really lovely on the face and is silky smooth. The texture of this is on the thicker side. It’s tacky for a bit after putting it on; however, it does end up absorbing into the skin. I also haven’t experienced a

Axis-Y is not a familiar brand in Korean beauty industry but this product is packed with excellent ingredients and has great efficiency on skin conditioning - making your skin looks like you slept really well and ate something very healthy for few days. I will explain what it means. Ingredients: It's based with 73% of the bifida ferment filtrate - the same active ingredients as Estee Lauder's Night Advanced Serum. So practically, it's based with it, not the diluted version so you can actually enjoy the full potential this ingredient. It also contains enhanced polyglycerin-3, and the rest of them are all extracts and additional humectants. It used 1,2 hexanediol as preservative, which is considered safe than other preservatives like phenoxyethanol or parabens. It's really clean and also full of great actives. Texture: it's on the watery side but still, it makes skin hydrated, plumped and glow after few drops. It leaves skin nicely hydrated but it only leaves hints of stickiness so it is also pretty safe to be used under makeup in the morning as well. Effectiveness: I love bifida. It leaves skin in a great condition overall, just like I mentioned above - skin looks more radiant, pores are less visible and more rosy and plumped just like when you have really good sleep for a few days. I can definitely feel especially when I have to wear a make up. Definitely, it's near the holy grail products which I will definitely keep in my routine. Overall: It's not so expensive and it works

avis.titre: left my face slightly red but feeling great
avis.texte: I used this after washing, but before serum and moisturizer. Photo is after all were added. this goes on slightly tacky - one dropper enough for entire face - and takes several minutes to dry. I noticed my face kind of tingling after I put it on, but in a good way. My face looked a bit flushed for about 15-20 min after application, but it dissipated. It seems to slightly plump my mid 50's skin. I will continue using this bottled I'm going to try it on my crepey neck skin next.

This AXIS-Y Biome Radiating Intense Essence probiotic skincare product states it is for combination, dry skin. When I opened it, I did smell a slight musky scent. Upon application, it does feel a bit sticky, tacky on the skin and your hands with a slight itchy/tingly feeling is how I can best describe it. This sensation didn't last long though. My face was left feeling matte like, almost dry but not to the point where it felt tight. The product states it has adenosine which is supposed to help reduce wrinkles and fine lines. I have not used this long enough to stand by those claims. I wouldn't recommend this for dry skin since I did find it to be less moisturizing than I would like. You apply this after toner, morning and night, by gently tapping the product on your face, instead of rubbing it in.

avis.titre: Compare to Estēe Lauder Advanced Night Repair
avis.texte: AXIS-Y Biome Radiating Intensified Essence - This essence is an amazing find! It’s very similar to Estēe Lauder’s Advanced Night Repair Serum only better, in my opinion. Bifida Ferment Lysate is the one main ingredient in both products that makes them gems except it’s in higher concentration in this essence. There are a few additional anti-aging ingredients in this essence that make this one stand out like niacinamide and ceramide np. I apply this essence at night after cleansing and toning and my skin drinks it up. It glides on smoothly and there is a slight tacky feeling. I apply my hyaluronic acid serum next, followed by a night cream that contains ceramides and vitamin E. There is an herbal scent that may come from the essential oils but it’s not irritating or overly strong. My skin has been looking brighter and plumper, and I have better overall skin tone. For the price and compared to the more expensive name brand, this is totally worth purchasing!

I like this serum and it does not irritate my skin, it has no added fragrance in the ingredients but does have a very mild, spicy scent, not unpleasant, but I prefer unscented products. I like that the ingredients are clean by the EWG site. I have very sensitive eczema prone skin and this does not bother it. It does not feel heavy on my skin and absorbs completely. I would not buy this again because it has a fragrance, but it is a nice product and if you like naturally scented products this is for you.

This facial intensified essence is compatible to my combination skin type. I use it before applying SPF cream plus a.m. moisturizer to help balance the natural and radiant look all day. The 2nd application is after washing my face with gentle soap, followed by p.m. moisturizer for a softer, well hydrated skin overnight. Satisfied with the results. :)
